And then factoring in what I got from the County, which is this total,  which is 397, is basically when you' re doing something where you' re using a surface,  you' re putting in PickleRoll or sport court,  your per court cost,  when you' re just doing fencing,  court, and lighting,  comes out to about $ 50,000 a court. But here we were looking at 397, which was the rough order of magnitude as an estimate. I did present that cost estimate at the last Commission meeting, and it was around 720, $720,000 to install the elevator,  if that' s an option.
